response.sql: WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS state_total FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT state_total, 1.0 * state_total / NULLIF(SUM(state_total) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM state_totals), share_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.state_total) AS combined_transaction_total, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess FROM state_shares AS s CROSS JOIN share_average AS a WHERE s.share > a.average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A state whose transactions all have missing amounts has a total of zero. If the overall total is zero, shares are undefined and the result contains NULL values.
